notes.title: Update 1.1.4: To The Next Level
notes.notes:
Improved mechanics, new features, UI enhancements, and bug fixes for a better gaming experience. Enjoy updated leaderboards, achievements, and customization options!

Detailed Update Notes

Gameplay Mechanics{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171254/373711acad044c111019caa7d2acf5e242ebfd13.png

Better jump timing mechanics
Fly pad now destroys itself after being stuck for one second
Increased Hop-Along's jump height
Blink now saved position on late jumps
Candle lighting improved


New Features
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171254/9c9a5c918d2ce1391c5b007a9c8a80c86eeefab4.png


Level Leaderboard added to main menu
Added character change arrows
Added a new achievement for players who complete a blue candle run
Blink can now restart levels
Added cherry and candle counters at the top of the screen
Added more languages
Added a link to the Discord server
Blue Author Times added
Leaderboards per character implemented
Controller Vibrations added
Added ghost replay
Implemented viewing ghosts from leaderboard
All character achievement


UI Improvements{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171254/6ed1b9f207c86d18a8e4ca31d35e222150c1588d.png


Rank Number added to leaderboard
Improved leaderboard slider
Improved overall user interface experience in the menu
Exit confirmation popup added
Added a prompt (Hold To Continue)
Added Cherry and Candle progress per level on the leaderboard
Candles gradually change over to blue
Added splash screen
New mouse cursor
Candle color tween


Settings and Customization
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171254/da07ac95e45764fc6a22470603bd4953caca21c6.png


Saving Settings when you change it
Keyboard Sensitivity slider added in settings
Settings to toggle the ghost


Bug Fixes and Optimizations


BugFix: Rewriting best score on Steam Leaderboard
BugFix: Settings menu default music slider focus changed to master level
General Bug Fixes
Fixed Leaderboard bug (loosing scores)
Optimized the game
BugFix: Candlewick no longer double triggers a candle
BugFix: Closing on screen keyboard now keeps focus
BugFix: Character select displaying steamboard regardless of type selected
BugFix: Saving settings on resolution + show ghost change
BugFix: Demo recoding stopping early


We hope these updates improve your gaming experience. Enjoy the new features and improvements!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171254/e29a87e289e5b5c1a40b361a853e3a4558a414a4.png

notes.title: Update: Cherry Jump 1.0.12
notes.notes:
New achievement for blue candle runs, Blink's level restart, cherry/candle counters, improved menu UI, and higher jumps for Hop-Along. Enhancing gameplay and user experience!

Detailed Update Notes

New Achievement{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171254/373711acad044c111019caa7d2acf5e242ebfd13.png

Added a new achievement for players who complete a blue candle run
Adds more depth and replay ability to the game


Blink Ability Enhancement{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171254/6ed1b9f207c86d18a8e4ca31d35e222150c1588d.png

Blink can now restart levels
Improves gameplay flow and reduces frustration
Allows for quicker retry attempts on challenging levels


HUD Improvements

Added cherry and candle counters at the top of the screen
Provides players with clear, at-a-glance information
Helps in tracking progress and planning strategies


Menu UI Enhancements

Improved overall user interface experience in the menu


Hop-Along Upgrade{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171254/da07ac95e45764fc6a22470603bd4953caca21c6.png

Increased Hop-Along's jump height


We hope these updates improve your Cherry Jump experience. Happy jumping!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171254/89c477cb1823ccc9a48b5fbae35fadc8d359b910.png
